title: One outcome-first engineering guide and governing procedure

spec.description: Use one primary engineering agent and one golden-path skill with selectively loaded supporting references. Preserve decomposition, capability, architecture, authority, evaluation and learning expertise without independent skills until reuse or context requirements earn them. Establish the underlying goal, current deliverable, completion evidence and authorized scope using conversation and safely discoverable context. Ask focused questions only for unresolved choices that materially affect the next step; proceed with clear authorized work without mandatory intake. Reassess affected intent and scope as conversation or evidence changes, preserving settled decisions. Distinguish discussion, critique, correction, cancellation and redirection from implementation or execution approval. Neither an artifact request nor a possible downstream need grants broader scope. No runtime architecture is implied.
